scripts.db:status: cd backend && npx prisma migrate status
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed:run: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx tsc prisma/seed.ts --esModuleInterop --module commonjs --target es2020 --outDir prisma/dist --skipLibCheck --types node && node prisma/dist/prisma/seed.js
scripts.db:seed:run:with-generate: npm run db:sync && npm run db:seed:run
scripts.db:sync: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:clear: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx tsx prisma/clear.ts
scripts.db:constraints: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx tsx prisma/enforce-role-fields.ts
